title: Questions and answers: mikor, milyen gyakran

sections.content: You know *hová?* and *mikor?* from Units 12 and 14. A question word stands right before the verb: *Mikor tanulsz?* (When do you study?) *Milyen gyakran sportolsz?* (How often do you do sport?) *Hol ebédelsz?* (Where do you have lunch?) There is no word for “do”. The answer starts with the time, the frequency or the place that replaces the question word.
English adds “do”: “When do you study?” Hungarian has no helper: *Mikor tanulsz?* is literally “When study you?”.
